title: A map model: res/field/maps/models/<model>/data.json
description: A map model of archive a/0/0/8, whose geometry, materials and placed props are model.glb next to this file and whose collision terrain is its terrain CSVs. tools/data/map_model_data.py packs them in the order of generated/map_models.txt. A string value is the name of a constant from generated/.

texture_set.description: The texture set the model's materials bind to, where the map matrices' areas or the resource names show it, or null where they don't. Only a model with one can have its texture bindings edited, since the set the game loads depends on the area

texture_preview.description: For a model with no texture_set, one of the sets that has every texture and palette it names, which its GLB shows in Blender

written.description: Set when the packer writes the whole model from the GLB (tools/data/nitro_model_writer.py) instead of editing the game's: a material for each GLB material, bound by its image to the texture_set's texture, and a draw call for each primitive, so the GLB can add materials and draw calls. The model needs its texture_set, and the GLB's positions as the model draws them

template.description: For a map model added after the game's in generated/map_models.txt: the game's map model whose chunk it copies (its type, its collision's size and layers, its props' section) and whose model name its GLB's mesh has. Its model is written whole ("written": true)

transformed.description: Set when the GLB's positions went through the model's node transforms on export, which the packer reverses
